speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: asked	the Minister for National Development which three Town Councils have the largest number of flats eligible for upgrading under the Home Improvement Programme.

speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
text: Can I confirm if there are any plans to increase the number of nominations for these three Town Councils, considering that they have the highest number of eligible units?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: And so, that means working with Aljunied-Hougang, Jurong-Clementi and Nee Soon Town Councils and all other Town Councils with outstanding HIP-eligible flats to meet that target.
